regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow, four-theme eligible rotation led by Banks (H + HK) with Energy (H-shares) as a close challenger (margin 0.065). The absolute-trend gate has historically helped risk control here (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak, so leadership is an attention lens only. All 17 themes are unscorable except two mean-reverting tech themes with no ETF-specific proof of edge, so any directional lean rests on judgment, not detector alpha.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) overtakes Banks (H + HK) as rotation leader. The observable that would retire this watch is Energy's rank score exceeding Banks' score by more than 0.15 with both still eligible for two consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks hold the top momentum rank and are eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with durability_bar at 0.66 and breadth 0.615 — decent but not one-narrative dominance (one_narrative false). The trend gate is the only validated leg for staying-power, and banks currently pass it. This is a cap-and-hold, not a chase: crowding_z 0.8 is not crowded, so no reflexivity fade pressure.
evidence: rotation leader with narrow eligible set (4/17)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mixed, not trend — the trend-health leg is unsure, and with only 4 of 17 themes eligible the leadership is narrow and fragile; a single macro shock to HK financials could break the breadth assumption.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) breadth drops below 0.4 or durability_bar falls under 0.5 before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is a close challenger to banks with score 1.413, and carries the strongest trend-health profile in the eligible set: durability_bar 0.82, hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.9. That breadth is the most cohesive among eligible themes and sits on a validated trend-gate pass. Judged purely on staying-power texture, energy looks more durable than banks despite the slightly lower rank.
evidence: rotation challenger, margin only 0.065 behind leader
theses.dissent: Energy is commodity-linked and historically mean-reverts hard in H-shares when global demand or oil prices turn; the 0.82 durability_bar may be recency-biased and the rank gap to banks is tiny enough to vanish next session.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) breadth falls below 0.6 or hurst_tag flips to mean-revert before the 20-day check-by date.

The detector's one validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, and this theme fails it. No reason to allocate and the mean-revert tag argues against fighting the tape.
